ADENA FRIEDMAN (Chair and CEO): 1,965,986 shares, including 147,000 shares gifted to two family trusts for her children; less than 1% (marked * in the proxy), so pctEconomic is null. Wellington (7.3%) and BlackRock (5.3%) are left out by the three-holder limit and named in the structure note; Thoma Bravo no longer appears among 5% holders. The proxy reports each 'as of the record date' but bases each on an earlier filing (Vanguard 13G/A Oct 6, 2025; Investor AB Form 4 Feb 13, 2026; Borse Dubai 13D/A Mar 22, 2024; BlackRock 13G Jan 31, 2024, stale), so asOf is null. Vanguard's footnote adds that a March 27, 2026 13G/A reported an internal realignment under which some Vanguard subsidiaries now report separately; the 10.5% is the aggregated October 2025 figure. Borse Dubai is typed 'company': the proxy describes it only as a wholly owned subsidiary of Investment Corporation of Dubai. BUYBACKS exclude $69 million of 'Payments related to employee shares withheld for taxes' and $4 million of accrued, unpaid excise tax. ROUNDING: dividends 601 -> 0.60, buybacks 616 -> 0.62, stock comp 165 -> 0.17 (half-up). GEOGRAPHY: total revenues of $8,262 million are gross, before transaction-based expenses (revenues less transaction-based expenses were $5,249 million).
